semantics.identity_rule: Capability, operation, bounds profile, validation and authorization identities remain distinct.
semantics.authority_rule: Capability visibility grants no execution authority.
semantics.action_rule: edit-binding/edit-bounds operations invoke separate authorized workflows.
semantics.graph_rule: Capability/bounds edges correspond only to explicit refs.
semantics.failure_rule: missing/incompatible/unknown capability or bounds remain explicit.

invariants.rule: Definitions, requests, validation evidence, authorization decisions and concrete executions remain separate identities; only an explicit validated and authorized dispatcher path may create effects.
